findings.finding: Rendering on `to_wire` while `normalize_outbound` stays identity violates the pinned codec law `normalize_outbound(t) == decode_inbound(to_wire(t))`, which the outbound comment differ's dedup key depends on.
findings.location: Approach ('Leave normalize_outbound/fit_outbound … unchanged')
findings.suggested_fix: Make `normalize_outbound` return `decode_inbound(to_wire(t))` (the round-trip preview) so the law holds and both the description and comment differs converge — this also fixes the description non-convergence finding.

findings.finding: The plan's Testing/AC set omits any assertion that DC descriptions still CONVERGE (a second pass emits zero description updates) after to_wire is wired in — the exact property the pre-existing convergence test guards and that this change threatens.
findings.location: Testing / Acceptance Criteria (all five ACs)

findings.finding: The plan adds a 'pinned pypandoc extra' to pyproject.toml without stating whether pypandoc folds into the EXISTING [jira-datacenter] extra or creates a new separate extra, and whether it is added to the optionality ban-list and lazily imported per the established DC-dependency convention.
findings.location: Scope: 'pyproject.toml — pinned pypandoc extra'
findings.suggested_fix: Declare `pypandoc` under the existing `[jira-datacenter]` optional-dependency group in pyproject.toml, import it lazily inside wiki_render.py, and add `pypandoc`/`pandoc` to the `_optionality.yml` clean-wheel ban-list assertion.

findings.finding: The plan pins a `pypandoc` extra but never states that the `pandoc` BINARY is a required runtime system prerequisite. pypandoc is only a thin wrapper that shells out to a `pandoc` executable; a plain `pypandoc` install does not include the renderer. This diverges from the repo's own pattern where external binaries (git, acli) are documented as 'System prerequisites (not pip deps)' (pyproject.toml:70).
findings.location: Scope → 'pyproject.toml — pinned `pypandoc` extra.' / Approach (pinned `pandoc`)
findings.suggested_fix: In Scope/Approach, add: pandoc binary is a documented system prerequisite for DC rich-text rendering (or pin `pypandoc-binary`); when pandoc is unavailable, `to_wire` falls back to identity passthrough (raw Markdown, today's behavior) rather than raising.
